options.en: Could you tell me where is the station?
options.bn: Could you tell me where is the station?

options.en: Could you tell me where the station is?
options.bn: Could you tell me where the station is?

options.en: Could you tell me where does the station is?
options.bn: Could you tell me where does the station is?

options.en: Could you tell me where the station does be?
options.bn: Could you tell me where the station does be?

why.en: Embedded questions after phrases like "Could you tell me" keep statement word order — no inversion.
why.bn: "Could you tell me"-এর পরে embedded question statement word order রাখে — inversion হয় না।

q.en: "___ broke the window?" — who is the subject here, so which is correct?
q.bn: "___ broke the window?" — এখানে who হলো subject, তাই কোনটা সঠিক?

options.en: Who did break
options.bn: Who did break

options.en: Who broke
options.bn: Who broke

options.en: Did who break
options.bn: Did who break

options.en: Who does broke
options.bn: Who does broke

why.en: When who/what/which is the subject of the sentence, no auxiliary is needed — it behaves like a statement.
why.bn: who/what/which যখন sentence-এর subject হয়, তখন auxiliary লাগে না — statement-এর মতো behave করে।

q.en: Turn into an indirect question: "Is the library open on Sundays?"
q.bn: Indirect question বানাও: "Is the library open on Sundays?"

options.en: I wonder is the library open on Sundays.
options.bn: I wonder is the library open on Sundays.

options.en: I wonder if the library is open on Sundays.
options.bn: I wonder if the library is open on Sundays.

options.en: I wonder the library is open on Sundays.
options.bn: I wonder the library is open on Sundays.

options.en: I wonder does the library open on Sundays.
options.bn: I wonder does the library open on Sundays.

why.en: A yes/no question with no question word to embed uses "if" or "whether" instead, plus statement word order.
why.bn: Yes/no question-এ embed করার কোনো question word না থাকলে "if" বা "whether" লাগে, সাথে statement word order।

q.en: Fix: "I don't know what time does the train leave."
q.bn: ঠিক করো: "I don't know what time does the train leave."

options.en: I don't know what time the train leaves.
options.bn: I don't know what time the train leaves.

options.en: I don't know what time leaves the train.
options.bn: I don't know what time leaves the train.

options.en: I don't know what time does leave the train.
options.bn: I don't know what time does leave the train.

options.en: I don't know what time the train does leave.
options.bn: I don't know what time the train does leave.

why.en: Embedded questions drop "does/do/did" and go back to statement word order: subject before verb.
why.bn: Embedded question-এ "does/do/did" বাদ যায়, statement word order ফিরে আসে: subject verb-এর আগে।

q.en: Which direct question has NO auxiliary verb (do/does/did/is/are)?
q.bn: কোন direct question-এ কোনো auxiliary verb নেই (do/does/did/is/are)?

options.en: What did you buy?
options.bn: What did you buy?

options.en: What happened?
options.bn: What happened?

options.en: Does she work here?
options.bn: Does she work here?

options.en: Is he coming?
options.bn: Is he coming?

why.en: "What happened?" asks about the subject itself, so it needs no auxiliary — same pattern as "Who called you?"
why.bn: "What happened?" subject নিজেই জিজ্ঞেস করছে, তাই auxiliary লাগে না — "Who called you?"-এর মতো pattern।
